The nullifier's mouths gnash incoherently while it can see any enemies. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the nullifier and can hear it must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. Unless the save succeeds, the creature rolls a d8 to determine what it does during the current turn:

  • 1-4:.

    The creature is stunned until the end of the turn.

  • 5-6:.

    The creature is frightened until the end of the turn and uses its movement to get as far as possible from the nullifier.

  • 7-8:.

    The creature doesn't move, and it uses its action to make one melee attack against a random creature (other than itself) if one is within reach. It otherwise does nothing

If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.

The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk. spellcasting.header: Skr'a S'orsk is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). Skr'a S'orsk has the following druid spells prepared:

spells.name: Thorn Whip
spells.components: V, S, M (the stem of a plant with thorns)

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust)

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.descriptionHtml: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack (Lizardfolk Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: The lizardfolk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage in crocodile form. If the lizardfolk is in crocodile form and the target is a Large or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the lizardfolk can't bite another target. If the lizardfolk reverts to its true form, the grapple ends.

actions.name: Claws (Lizardfolk Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Change Shape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.descriptionHtml: The lizardfolk magically polymorphs into a crocodile, remaining in that form for up to 1 hour. It can revert to its true form as a bonus action. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.descriptionHtml: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny snake. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Bites
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}7 (2d6) piercing damage, or 3 (1d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

macro.targets: one creature in the swarm's space

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.descriptionHtml: The basilisk can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Petrifying Secretions
traits.descriptionHtml: A creature must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw if it hits the basilisk with a weapon attack while within 5 feet of it or if it starts its turn grappled by the basilisk. Unless the save succeeds, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained, and it must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The basilisk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12).

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The captain makes three melee attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its dagger. Or the captain makes two ranged attacks with its daggers.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.descriptionHtml: mw,rw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.descriptionHtml: The captain adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the captain must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Charge
traits.descriptionHtml: If the udaak moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet away from the udaak and knocked prone.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.descriptionHtml: The udaak deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The udaak makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its slam.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}21 (2d12 + 8) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 21). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the udaak can't bite another target.

actions.name: Slam
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.descriptionHtml:
The udaak makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the udaak, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the udaak's turns.

If the udaak takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the udaak must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the udaak. If the udaak dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Voice Lock
traits.descriptionHtml: The vox seeker must move toward and attack the source of the nearest voice within 60 feet of it, to the exclusion of all other targets, for as long as it remains operational.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.descriptionHtml: The vox seeker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 3 lightning damage.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.descriptionHtml: Yinra has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.descriptionHtml: Yinra has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.descriptionHtml: rw +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
